verdict.rationale: Browserbase clearly provides managed remote browser sessions that developers can create, control, and observe (docs-1, docs-22, docs-9). It also offers a live view and session replay (docs-26) and lets agent runs pause for human input (docs-23). However, the evidence frames these sessions as programmatic or agent-driven, and nothing shows a developer manually browsing interactively inside the sandbox. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of human-driven interactive control (e.g., clicking or typing through a live view), hands-on or independent corroboration of manual browsing workflows.
